option_a.name: Pin Django 5.x (RECOMMENDED)
option_a.action: Create requirements.txt pinning Django>=5.0,<5.3; install Django 5.x
option_a.risk: Django 5.x may not be available for Python 3.13; network install needed

option_b.name: Adapt code to Django 6.0.x
option_b.action: Update deprecated APIs in working copy code for Django 6.0.6 compatibility
option_b.risk: May require code changes in views/models; more invasive

option_c.name: Accept existing pass rate
option_c.action: Document 13/23 as baseline; note Django version mismatch for future fix

recommendation: option_b (adapt to Django 6.x) — no network needed, minimal code changes, safer for local dev on Python 3.13
